result.summary: The page layout is mostly intact, but the featured 'Popular right now' card for Tokumaru Ramen Bar has a broken/missing image, leaving a large empty gray placeholder block. A related styling inconsistency affects the favorite button overlay on that card.

issues.description: The hero image for the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section fails to load, showing a generic broken-image icon on an empty light gray block. This makes the card look unfinished compared to the pizza card below it, which renders correctly.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL/asset for this restaurant, and add a branded fallback (e.g. cuisine illustration or restaurant initials on a colored background) instead of a broken-image glyph when the source fails.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card uses a mid-gray translucent circle over a light gray placeholder, giving weak contrast; the equivalent button on the pizza card below uses a dark circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent button treatment (solid dark or white circle with sufficient icon contrast) regardless of the underlying image state.

issues.description: The '€0 delivery' badge and heart icon float over an empty placeholder area, so the card's overlay elements appear disconnected from any content.
issues.suggestion: When no image is available, render badges on the fallback background block so overlays still read as part of a cohesive card.
